answer: Sybil cost here is locked capital, not prose. Each identity must post a non-transferable vault bond in JADE stake, slashed whenever its attestation cluster disagrees with the quill-anchored reference set drawn only from already-settled answers, never from fresh submissions. Audits are unannounced and payout is weighted by bond age, so throwaway keys earn nothing: a farmer running N identities must fund N independent bonds and survive repeated slash rounds every epoch, in capital it cannot recycle.
